landing.heroDesc: Yakha imikhuba yeemali ehle ngokuhlela ibhajethi ngokuhlakanipha, ukuhlela ukulondoloza, kanye nokuqondiswa ngqo — koke kuhlelelwe isimo seemali seSewula Afrika.

features.aiCoachDesc: Iseluleko esiqondiswe ngqo esisetjenziswa yi-AI eyazi ibhajethi yakho, iminqopho yokulondoloza, nemikhuba yokusebenzisa imali
features.smartBudgetDesc: Landelela ukusebenzisa imali ngokwesigaba ngamabha aqhubekako nezaziso zokusebenzisa ngokudlulisako
features.savingsGoalsDesc: Beka iminqopho enomqamulajuqu uthole iincomo ezihlakanipaako ukufika khona msinyana
features.healthScoreDesc: Isikali esiguqukako esibonisa imali engenako, ukusebenzisa, isilinganiso sokulondoloza, nepilo yesikwelede

steps.step1Desc: Faka imali engenako yakho wenze iinkamba zokusebenzisa imali
steps.step2Desc: Tlola iindleko ubeke iminqopho yokulondoloza enomqamulajuqu
steps.step3Desc: Buza umqeqetshi wakho we-AI iseluleko seemali esiqondiswe ngqo

landing.testimonial: I-MaliMind ingisizile ukulondoloza u-R15,000 wesikwama sami sezinto eziqubukako ngenyanga ezine kwaphela. Umqeqetshi we-AI ungibamba nginomthwalo ngendlela engazange yenzeke nge-app.

savings.title: Iminqopho Yokulondoloza
savings.noGoals: Awukabi neminqopho yokulondoloza. Yenza owakho wokuthoma!

coach.title: Umqeqetshi Weemali we-AI
coach.greeting: Lotjhani! Ngingumqeqetshi wakho weemali we-MaliMind AI. Ngiyakghona ukubona ibhajethi yakho, iminqopho yokulondoloza, nesikali sepilo yeemali — ngalokho iseluleko sami siqondiswe esimeni sakho. Ufuna ukusizwa ngani namhlanjesi?
coach.limitReached: Ufikile emkhawulweni wemilayezo yamahhala yamalanga. Kuphuphurela ku-Pro ukufumana ukuqeqeshwa okunganamkhawulo!
coach.error: Uxolo, angikghonanga ukukuphendula lokho. Linga godu.

suggestions.save: Ngingalondoloza njani ngokungeziweko ngemali engenako yami?
suggestions.stokvel: Kufanele ngijoyine istokfela namkha ngivule i-TFSA?
suggestions.emergency: Isikwama sami sezinto eziqubukako kufanele sibe yimalini?

premium.proDesc: Thabela ukuqeqeshwa kweemali kwe-AI okunganamkhawulo nezici eziphrimiyamu.
premium.upgradeDesc: Vula amandla apheleko wokuqeqeshwa kweemali okusetjenziswa yi-AI.
